TrulySafe

Trust, by design.

A connected brand experience across packaging, the website and social media guidelines.

Packaging designWebsite designSocial media guidelines

THE PROJECT

One brand. Every touchpoint.

TrulySafe is a food staples brand centred on safety and transparency. My work covered packaging design, website design and social media guidelines, connecting the brand across physical products and digital experiences.

01 / PACKAGING ↘02 / WEBSITE ↘03 / SOCIAL GUIDELINES ↘

01 / PACKAGING

A family on the shelf.

The packaging brings the range together through a consistent layout, a bright yellow frame and a prominent brand mark. Product names, food imagery and the QR code each have a clear place, helping shoppers recognise the brand and distinguish one product from another.

PACK TO SCREEN

Designed to carry the story further.

The QR code connects the pack with the brand’s batch-report experience. Keeping this touchpoint visible makes it part of the packaging hierarchy, alongside the product and brand information.

02 / WEBSITE

The brand, beyond the pack.

The website gives the brand story more room to unfold. I worked on its design, carrying TrulySafe’s visual language into a digital experience that brings the product range, sourcing story and testing information together.

BRAND CONTINUITY

From shelf to screen.

A shared colour and image language connects the website with the packaging.

INFORMATION DESIGN

A clearer hierarchy.

Distinct sections give the brand story, product discovery and report information their own space.

03 / SOCIAL MEDIA GUIDELINES

A recognisable voice, post after post.

My scope also included social media guidelines: a framework for keeping the brand recognisable across recurring content. The focus is consistency in colour, typography, layout and the balance between product imagery and information.

A CONSISTENT BRAND LANGUAGE
01

Colour with purpose.

Keep the brand palette recognisable across product-led and informational content.

02

Make the message clear.

Use a clear type hierarchy so the main idea is easy to find.

03

Give every element a role.

Balance product imagery, supporting information and space within a repeatable layout.
